title: Staging recovery optional grant surface reconciliation

phases.objective: Make destructive local Staging database recovery honor the canonical optional grant-surface contract before any authority mutation, while preserving fail-closed handling for missing required surfaces and keeping Production untouched.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Recovery preflights repository-owned grant surfaces before authority mutation, grants only surfaces that exist, records absent optional surfaces as degraded evidence, and fails before REVOKE or GRANT if any required surface is absent.
steps: Resolve the canonical per-role grant plan and query INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES for every declared grant surface before constructing authority mutation SQL.

Add present surfaces to effectiveGrants, record absent optional surfaces without a GRANT statement, and fail closed on an absent required surface before CREATE USER, ALTER USER, REVOKE, or GRANT execution.
Build both grant SQL and same-cycle privilege readback expectations from effectiveGrants only, preserving least privilege and degraded optional-surface evidence.
assertions: v_platform_evolution_activation_card remains an optional runtime read surface and its absence does not produce a GRANT or block recovery.
A missing required grant surface remains blocking before any authority mutation.
No CREATE VIEW, manual GRANT, schema-wide authority, GRANT OPTION, Production access, provider mutation, Hostinger mutation, or Cloudflare mutation is introduced.
The change requires live Staging certification after merge and authorizes no Production mutation.
